title: EntraProvenanceV1
description: Entra x AtlaSent acceptance-slice provenance: the tenant-binding and authority-mapping facts v1-idp-broker resolved when it minted an envelope through Entra ID. Carried inside the SIGNED payload of approval_artifact.v1 (relation "approve") and actor_identity.v1 (relation "request"), so it is authenticated exactly like every other envelope field. Absent on every non-Entra envelope. Mirrors atlasent-api supabase/functions/_shared/entra-provenance.ts (EntraProvenanceV1, isEntraProvenanceV1); mirrored in atlasent/schemas/v1_1/entra-provenance.schema.json (checked by contract/tools/check_root_schema_mirror.py). The SDK only carries it. Added 2026-10-03, additive only.

tenant_id.description: Verified Entra tenant id (the `tid` claim) the envelope was authenticated against.

org_binding_id.description: id of the entra_tenant_org_bindings row whose currency was checked at mint time.

mapping_id.description: id of the entra_authority_mappings row that granted eligibility for `relation` on the envelope's action_type, checked at mint time.

mapping_version.description: version of that entra_authority_mappings row at mint time. The runtime guard accepts any finite number; the database column is INTEGER CHECK (version > 0).

relation.description: Which eligibility this provenance proves: "request" on actor_identity.v1, "approve" on approval_artifact.v1.
